{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Identify rows with missing body_mass_g or flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper_or_mass = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull() | penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull()

# Check the species and island of those rows
missing_rows = penguins[missing_flipper_or_mass][['species', 'island', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']]
print(missing_rows)"}
